origin.description: Tolerances and iteration limits for the EM algorithm.

arguments.name: eps
arguments.text: Singularity tolerance. The default is machine precision. A negative value, or a value of 1 or more, is an error.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Relative convergence tolerances for the log-likelihood and for the inner loop. One number is used for both. The default inner tolerance is the square root of machine precision.

arguments.name: itmax
arguments.text: Iteration limits for the outer loop and the inner loop. One number sets only the outer limit. An infinite limit becomes the largest integer.

arguments.name: equalPro
arguments.text: Whether the mixing proportions are equal. The default is false.

origin.details: A length-1 tol is repeated. A length-1 itmax is paired with the largest integer, and Inf is replaced after that pairing.
origin.value: A named list with eps, tol, itmax, and equalPro.
origin.example: print(emControl(eps = 1e-8, tol = 1e-4, itmax = Inf, equalPro = TRUE))
